remarks: Charming Colonial offering 3 bedrooms with additional finished attic space and a bonus room with full bath, providing flexibility for extended living, home office, or guest setup. The former garage has been converted into additional living space. Hardwood flooring throughout much of the home. Recent updates include a newer roof and a brand new hot water heater. Central air and natural gas heating. Set back from the street, the property offers a private, fenced-in yard. Located in an excellent Stamford location within walking distance to the train station; a true commuter's dream. This home presents a great opportunity for buyers looking to add value and customize to their taste while benefiting from a prime location. HIGHEST AND BEST OFFERS ARE DUE ON MONDAY 5/11/26 @7PM.
